nodes.summary: The standardized DENTIST difference has mean zero iff the reference correlation equals the true correlation or the lead variant has mean zero (for `r ^ 2 < 1`).
nodes.title: Zero-mean criterion for the DENTIST difference

nodes.summary: The mean `(ρ - r) λ / √(1 - r²)` of the standardized DENTIST difference when the true correlation is `ρ`, the reference correlation is `r` and the lead variant has mean `λ`.
nodes.title: Mean of the standardized DENTIST difference

nodes.summary: The DENTIST-S statistic `(z_i - r z_c) ^ 2 / (1 - r ^ 2)` of a variant with `z`-score `zi`, given the `z`-score `zc` of the lead (putative causal) variant and the reference correlation `r` between them (Kanai et al. 2022, Equation 1). Meaningful for `r ^ 2 < 1`; for `r ^ 2 = 1` it is `0` by the convention `x / 0 = 0`.
nodes.title: DENTIST-S statistic

nodes.summary: The standardized DENTIST difference has unit variance iff the reference correlation is `0` or equals the true correlation (for `r ^ 2 < 1`).
nodes.title: Unit-variance criterion for the DENTIST difference

nodes.summary: The variance `(1 - 2 r ρ + r²) / (1 - r²)` of the standardized DENTIST difference when the true correlation is `ρ` and the reference correlation is `r`.
nodes.title: Variance of the standardized DENTIST difference

nodes.summary: Under the model of `map_standardized_eq_gaussianReal` with reference correlation equal to the true correlation `ρ` (`ρ ^ 2 < 1`), the DENTIST-S statistic has the `chiSquareMeasure 1` law, for every value `λ` of the lead variant's mean.
nodes.title: DENTIST-S is exactly `χ²₁` when the reference LD is right

nodes.summary: When the reference correlation equals the true correlation `ρ` (`ρ ^ 2 < 1`), the DENTIST-S statistic has the law of the square of a standard normal variable.
nodes.title: DENTIST-S is chi-squared with one degree of freedom under correct LD

nodes.summary: Let `(z_i, z_c)` be jointly Gaussian with unit variances, correlation `ρ` (the covariance, as the variances are `1`), and means `ρ λ` and `λ`. For a reference correlation `r` with `r ^ 2 < 1`, the standardized difference `(z_i - r z_c) / √(1 - r²)` is Gaussian with mean `dentistMean ρ r λ` and variance `dentistVariance ρ r`.
nodes.title: Exact law of the standardized DENTIST difference
